candidates.description: This feature vector activates common English intransitive and linking verbs that frequently take prepositional or clausal complements.
This vector represents forms of the verb "to be" across multiple Romance languages.
This vector is related to conjugated third-person and first-person modal and auxiliary verbs across multiple Romance and Germanic languages.
This vector represents first-person plural pronouns and related verbal inflections across multiple languages.
This vector represents common German auxiliary and modal verbs in various conjugated forms.
This vector represents abstract thoughts, ideas, and intellectual concepts.
This vector is related to personal and reflexive pronouns across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents adverbial suffixes and intensifying adverbs across multiple Romance and Germanic languages.
This vector represents the concept of possibility, likelihood, and potential outcomes across multiple languages.
This vector activates for words, terms, and figures related to philosophy and academic disciplines of the humanities.
